certification_cutline.description: Rows at or above Stable carry the certified open-durability claim; a certification gap on a still-stable row holds promotion through the shiproom gate.

rules.title: Boundary manifest missing
rules.rationale: A still-stable row that narrows on boundary manifest missing holds promotion until the gap clears; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream.

records.title: Framework release row
records.subject_summary: Core framework release row across all six durability axes.
records.rationale: The boundary manifest is published and release-linked, REUSE/SPDX and notices/SBOM are bound, imports are attributed and owned, the signer quorum is met with backup authority, the emergency drill is current, and the critical upstreams are healthy; with fresh proof and owner sign-off the row is certified.

records.title: Notebook ecosystem row
records.subject_summary: Notebook extension/provider ecosystem row across all six axes.
records.rationale: Every durability axis holds for the notebook ecosystem row, with fresh certification proof and owner sign-off; the row is certified.

records.title: Data-rich release row
records.subject_summary: Data-rich result-grid release row with an unpublished boundary manifest.
records.rationale: The versioned boundary manifest for this row is not published or release-linked; the row narrows on the boundary axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: AI-adjacent ecosystem row
records.subject_summary: AI-adjacent ecosystem row that depends on a hidden proprietary baseline.
records.rationale: The row's open-boundary claim rests on a hidden proprietary baseline; it narrows on the boundary axis and holds promotion — a row may not be certified open while it depends on a hidden proprietary baseline.

records.title: Review release row
records.subject_summary: Review/diff release row with stale REUSE/SPDX licensing coverage.
records.rationale: The REUSE/SPDX file-level licensing coverage has aged out of its review window; the row narrows on the compliance axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: Companion ecosystem row
records.subject_summary: Companion-surface ecosystem row whose notice inventory and SBOM are unbound.
records.rationale: The third-party notice inventory and SBOM are not bound to the row's artifacts; it narrows on the compliance axis and holds promotion — a green SBOM card may not mask a missing notice binding.

records.title: Managed-depth release row
records.subject_summary: Managed-depth release row with an unattributed third-party import.
records.rationale: A third-party import on this row carries no origin/license/upstream-pin provenance; it narrows on the import axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: Framework ecosystem row
records.subject_summary: Framework ecosystem row with an ownerless critical import.
records.rationale: A critical import on this row has no update owner; it narrows on the import axis and holds promotion — a row may not be certified while it depends on an ownerless critical import.

records.title: Notebook release row
records.subject_summary: Notebook release row whose signer quorum is below requirement.
records.rationale: The signing lane requires three distinct humans but only two are available; the row narrows on the authority axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: Data-rich ecosystem row
records.subject_summary: Data-rich ecosystem row whose emergency authority is one irreplaceable human.
records.rationale: The emergency signing/registry/security authority for this row resolves to a single irreplaceable human with no backup; it narrows on the authority axis and holds promotion — a row may not be certified while it depends on a single-person emergency authority.

records.title: AI-adjacent release row
records.subject_summary: AI-adjacent release row whose emergency-response drill evidence is stale.
records.rationale: The advisory/revocation/disable drill evidence for this row has aged out; it narrows on the emergency-response axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: Review ecosystem row
records.subject_summary: Review ecosystem row that depends on a red-risk, unowned critical upstream.
records.rationale: A protected-path dependency for this row is red-risk and unowned with no approved sponsor/fork/replace plan; it narrows on the upstream axis and holds promotion on a still-stable claim.

records.title: Managed-depth ecosystem row
records.subject_summary: Managed-depth ecosystem row whose certification proof aged out; already Beta.
records.rationale: The certification proof packet aged past its freshness SLO; the row narrows on the stale axis. The subject is already Beta, so the narrowing is inherited and gated upstream.

records.title: Companion release row
records.subject_summary: Companion release row with no captured certification proof; already Beta.
records.rationale: No certification proof packet is captured; the row narrows on the stale axis. The subject is already Beta, so the narrowing is inherited.

records.title: Review managed release row
records.subject_summary: Review managed release row with a boundary gap held by an approved waiver.

waiver.reason: Boundary manifest re-publication in progress; covered by an approved, time-boxed waiver.

records.rationale: A boundary manifest not yet re-published, held by an unexpired waiver: it stays visible and narrowed on the boundary axis but is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Companion preview ecosystem row
records.subject_summary: Companion preview ecosystem row with an unpublished boundary manifest; already Beta.
records.rationale: The boundary manifest for this row is not yet published; it narrows on the boundary axis. The subject is already Beta, so the narrowing is inherited.

scan_surface_parity.rationale: Every row's certification scan and service-health/release-center/support surface agree, so a green certification card can never mask a hidden proprietary baseline, an ownerless critical import, a single-person emergency authority, a stale notice/SBOM, an uncovered drill, or an unhealthy upstream.

publication.rationale: Hold while any release-blocking row carries an open-durability certification gap on a still-stable claim; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream. A row that depends on a hidden proprietary baseline, an ownerless critical import, or a single-person emergency authority may not widen a stable claim without an approved plan.
